visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a green and white striped t-shirt and blue jeans, stands in a bright white room. She holds a dark grey iPad Air and smiles at the camera. To her left is a vase of dried flowers on a pinkish window sill. (2) Close-up on a white knitted surface. A person's hands connect a white USB-C card reader to an iPad lying flat. A black digital camera is also visible. (3) Screen recording shows multiple photos being selected and imported into the iPad's system. (4) The woman is seen from behind her shoulder, sitting and using an Apple Pencil Pro to edit her portrait in Photoshop for iPad. She is using the healing brush tool. (5) Close-up of the iPad screen showing the 'Liquify' tool being used to adjust the silhouette of a person in a photo. (6) In Final Cut Pro for iPad, she uses the Apple Pencil to draw bright yellow handwritten text 'Live Drawing' over a video clip. (7) A full-screen video clip displays the woman walking, with the animated 'Live Drawing' handwritten text appearing over her. (8) Close-up of the iPad interface demonstrating the use of a digital jog wheel for precise video scrubbing. (9) The woman holds the iPad horizontally, playing the mobile game MapleStory. Her thumbs are active on the screen's virtual controls. (10) The woman is back in the standing position from the start, holding the iPad and speaking enthusiastically to the camera.

(6) [Slogan]: 1.快速的編輯圖片. (7) [Subtitle]: 首先是可以快速的編輯圖片. (8) [Subtitle]: 我會直接插入Type-C接口的讀卡機. (9) [Subtitle]: 快速輸入照片到iPad裡面. (10) [Subtitle]: 打開Photoshop iPad版本. (11) [Subtitle]: 現在的PS iPad版功能也越來越齊全. (12) [Subtitle]: 非常好用. (13) [Subtitle]: 我也有搭配新的Apple Pencil Pro. (14) [Subtitle]: 可以直接用畫筆修容. (15) [Subtitle]: 修飾一些小瑕疵. (16) [Subtitle]: 這樣可以避免濾鏡軟體把照片變模糊的問題. (17) [Subtitle]: 另外也會簡單液化修飾身型. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Friendly female narrator speaks at a moderate pace with high clarity, introducing her life with the iPad Air. Background music is upbeat electronic pop with a steady synthesized drum beat. (2) As she discusses importing photos, a soft mechanical click SFX mimics the insertion of a card reader. The vocal tone is informative and enthusiastic. (3) During the editing demonstration, the music continues at the same tempo, providing a consistent high-energy backdrop. Faint digital UI 'pop' SFX are heard when tools are selected on screen. (4) Vocal arousal increases slightly when talking about 'Live Drawing' in Final Cut Pro. The acoustic environment is very clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio. (5) Game sounds from MapleStory, including character combat noises and UI jingles, are mixed under the narration, creating a more layered auditory experience during the gaming segment. (6) The video concludes with the narrator's cheerful sign-off. The music swells slightly before a hard cut to silence at the end of the timeline.
